item.content:encoded:
Organization: libretro

Status: filled

Compensation: gratis

Role: Icons Designer

The idea is to finish flatui icons theme for xmb menu theme which will be available in RetroArch and Lakka distribution.

RetroArch is the official reference frontend for the libretro API.

Lakka is a lightweight Linux distribution that transforms a small computer into a full blown game console.
